MINUTES
  MALIBU PLANNING COMMISSION
  SPECIAL MEETING
  JULY 28, 2022
  TELECONFERENCED — VARIOUS LOCATIONS
  10:00 A.M.

The following meeting was held pursuant t0 the Governor’s Executive Orders N—25—20
and N-29-20 and fully teleconferenced from various locations during the coronavirus
disease (COVID-I9) pandemic.

CALL TO ORDER

  Chair Hill called the meeting to order at 10:01 a.m.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance via teleconference by the Recording
  Secretary:

  PRESENT: Chair Kraig Hill, Vice Chair Dennis Robert Smith, and Commissioners
  Jeffrey Jennings, John G. Mazza, and Mark Wetton

  ALSO PRESENT: Trevor Rusin, Assistant City Attorney; Richard Mollica, Planning
  Director; Jesse Bobbett, Community Services Director, Jessica Thompson, Associate
  Plannen and Rebecca Evans, Recording Secretary

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Commissioner Mazza moved and Commissioner Jennings seconded a motion to
  approve the agenda as recommended by staff.

  The question was called and the motion carried unanimously.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Recording Secretary Evans reported that the agenda for the meeting was properly posted
  on July 27, 2022.

ITEM 1  NEW PUBLIC HEARINGS

  A. Appeal No. 22-005 - Appeal ofPlanning Director’s revocation of Temporary Use
  Permit No. 22-021 for the Sunset Jazz Fest
  Location: 23575 Civic Center Way
  APN: 4458-022-907
  Owner: City of Malibu
   Malibu Planning Commission
  Minutes ofJuly 283 2022
  Page 2 of3

  Appellant: Hudson Baxter
  Case Planner: Senior Planner Thompson, 456-2489, ext. 280
  Recommended Action: Adopt Planning Commission Resolution No. 22-52,
  denying Appeal No. 22-005, and upholding the revocation of Temporary Use
  Permit No. 22—021 for the Sunset Jazz Fest to be held in the Community
  Commercial zoning district at 23575 Civic Center Way.

  Senior Planner Thompson presented the staff repOIt.

  Chair Hill opened the public comment portion ofthe hearing.

  Speakers: Bruce lshimatsu, Shay Beebe, Hudson Baxter. Bill Sampson

  As there were no other speakers present, the public comment portion of the hearing
  was close and the matter was returned to the Commission for discussion.

MOTION  Commissioner Jennings moved and Vice Chair Smith seconded the motion to
  upholding Appeal No. 22-005. approving Temporary Use Permit No. 22-021, and
  adopting Planning Commission Resolution No. 22-52, as amended, l) no alcohol
  hall be sold or served at any time during the event; 2) all necessary paperwork to be
  submitted no later than 12:30 p.m. July 29, 2024; 3) by 5:30 p.m. PST on July 28,
  2022‘ all advertising for the event, including the event website, shall remove all
  references to alcohol sales and a notice of “no alcohol on premises” shall be
  prominently displayed on the website; the event website shall be modifying to
  remove all reference to alcohol service; for the Sunset Jazz Fest to be held in the
  Community Commercial zoning district at 23575 Civic Center Way.

FRIENDLY AMENDMENT
  Commissioner Mazza moved a friendly amendment to require a bag check upon
  entry for the event.

  The amendment was not accepted by the maker.

FRIENDLY AMENDMENT
  Commissioner Mazza moved a friendly amendment to The Temporary Use Permit
  holder shall be responsible for payment of parking taxes if not paid by the parking
  lot owner(s).

  The amendment was accepted by the maker and the seconder.
